note: Literature confirms KDM2B variants cause neurodevelopmental disorder with variable ocular and renal anomalies (e.g., solitary kidney, myopic astigmatism, structural eye defects).

evidence.text: Individuals with KDM2B CxxC domain variants exhibited ocular abnormalities including myopic astigmatism as well as renal anomalies such as solitary kidney and unilateral renal agenesis alongside cardiac and neurodevelopmental features.
